item: A stall record says how long the request spent before routing handed it to its endpoint
summary: Each stall record gains before_dispatch_ms read from latency.current_split(); null when the request was not stamped or the reader fails (unknown, never 0). Paid for inside the record, because the diagnostics part has no room: the redundant undetermined flag is dropped (consistent_with says it), the stall duration and the split are whole milliseconds, and pool holder ages are tenths of a second; a full 200-record ring of field-shaped records measures 336,400 B against 338,600 B before (net -2,200 B), pinned in a test. Lands after the latency change that supplies current_split; until then the field is null and the split test skips. Same bundle: a slow statement is named only when it ended inside the request and was not longer than it.
